title: Mulholland Drive
curatorNote: Eleito o melhor filme do século XXI pela revista britânica Sight & Sound. Uma aspirante a atriz em Los Angeles ajuda uma mulher amnésica a descobrir sua verdadeira identidade.
curatorReason: A obra máxima de David Lynch: um labirinto onírico, hipnótico e sedutor sobre ilusão, cinema, pesadelo e a fábrica de sonhos hollywoodiana.

omdb.title: Mulholland Drive
omdb.actors: Naomi Watts, Laura Harring, Justin Theroux
omdb.plot: After a car wreck on Mulholland Drive renders a woman amnesiac, she and a Hollywood-hopeful search for clues and answers across Los Angeles in a twisting venture beyond dreams and reality.
omdb.awards: Nominated for 1 Oscar. 50 wins & 61 nominations total

title: Blue Velvet
curatorNote: Ao encontrar uma orelha humana decepada em um gramado bucólico, um jovem é tragado para o submundo criminoso e sadomasoquista de uma cidadezinha americana.
curatorReason: Clássico absoluto do neo-noir surrealista onde Lynch expõe as pulsões sombrias e os desejos reprimidos sob a fachada de inocência suburbana.

omdb.title: Blue Velvet
omdb.actors: Isabella Rossellini, Kyle MacLachlan, Dennis Hopper
omdb.plot: A young man finds a severed human ear that is somehow connected to a mysterious lounge singer and a group of psychopathic criminals who have kidnapped her child.
omdb.awards: Nominated for 1 Oscar. 21 wins & 22 nominations total

title: The Discreet Charm of the Bourgeoisie
curatorNote: Vencedor do Oscar de Melhor Filme Estrangeiro. Um grupo aristocrático tenta repetidamente se reunir para um jantar elegante, mas é sempre interrompido por situações absurdas.
curatorReason: Luis Buñuel em sua melhor forma satírica: um ataque desconcertante e deliciosamente ácido aos rituais, hipocrisias e convenções da alta sociedade.

omdb.title: The Discreet Charm of the Bourgeoisie
omdb.actors: Fernando Rey, Delphine Seyrig, Paul Frankeur
omdb.plot: A surreal, virtually plotless series of dreams centered around six middle-class people and their consistently interrupted attempts to have a meal together.

title: The Holy Mountain
curatorNote: Um ladrão semelhante a Cristo é guiado por um mestre alquimista junto a sete figuras planetárias em uma jornada mística até o topo de uma montanha sagrada para alcançar a imortalidade.
curatorReason: Obra visualmente alucinante de Alejandro Jodorowsky repleta de alquimia, esoterismo, sátira social e plasticidade provocadora.

omdb.title: The Holy Mountain
omdb.actors: Alejandro Jodorowsky, Horacio Salinas, Zamira Saunders
omdb.plot: In a corrupt, greed-fueled world, a powerful alchemist leads a messianic character and seven materialistic figures to the Holy Mountain, where they hope to achieve enlightenment.

title: Eraserhead
curatorNote: Em uma paisagem industrial desolada e sombria, um jovem tímido precisa cuidar sozinho de uma criatura recém-nascida monstruosa e deformada.
curatorReason: A estreia monumental de David Lynch que definiu o surrealismo corporal independente americano com design de som aterrador e estética analógica.

omdb.title: Eraserhead
omdb.actors: Jack Nance, Charlotte Stewart, Allen Joseph
omdb.plot: Henry Spencer tries to survive his industrial environment, his angry girlfriend, and the unbearable screams of his newborn mutant child.

title: Lost Highway
curatorNote: Um saxofonista de jazz acusado de assassinar a própria esposa se transforma misteriosamente em um jovem mecânico dentro de sua cela na prisão.
curatorReason: Estrutura em fita de Möbius com estética noir expressionista, trilha elétrica de Angelo Badalamenti e Trent Reznor, e pura atmosfera de pesadelo.

omdb.title: Lost Highway
omdb.actors: Bill Pullman, Patricia Arquette, John Roselius
omdb.plot: Anonymous videotapes presage a musician's murder conviction, and a gangster's girlfriend leads a mechanic astray.

title: Last Year at Marienbad
curatorNote: Vencedor do Leão de Ouro no Festival de Veneza. Em um palácio barroco suntuoso com jardins geométricos, um homem tenta convencer uma mulher de que eles se conheceram no ano anterior.
curatorReason: Alain Resnais e Alain Robbe-Grillet revolucionam a narrativa moderna transformando o filme em um labirinto atemporal sobre memória, persuasão e ilusão.

omdb.title: Last Year at Marienbad
omdb.actors: Delphine Seyrig, Giorgio Albertazzi, Sacha Pitoëff
omdb.plot: In a strange and isolated chateau, a man becomes acquainted with a woman and insists that they have met before.
omdb.awards: Nominated for 1 Oscar. 2 wins & 5 nominations total

title: Holy Motors
curatorNote: Ao longo de um dia pelas ruas de Paris, um homem enigmático transportado em uma limusine branca encarna múltiplas personas: mendiga, assassino, monstro e pai de família.
curatorReason: A carta de amor febril e surreal de Leos Carax à arte da representação e à metamorfose contínua do cinema, com Denis Lavant em performance inacreditável.

omdb.title: Holy Motors
omdb.actors: Denis Lavant, Edith Scob, Eva Mendes
omdb.plot: A man boards a limousine to be driven to his day's work: nine mysterious "appointments."

title: Dead Man
curatorNote: Um contador ferido chamado William Blake foge para o interior selvagem ao lado de um indígena que acredita que ele seja a reencarnação do poeta britânico homônimo.
curatorReason: Faroeste lírico e onírico em preto e branco dirigido por Jim Jarmusch, com trilha improvisada em guitarra distorcida por Neil Young.

omdb.title: Dead Man
omdb.actors: Johnny Depp, Gary Farmer, Crispin Glover
omdb.plot: On the run after murdering a man, an accountant encounters a strange Native American man who prepares him for his journey into the spiritual world.

title: The Exterminating Angel
curatorNote: Após um banquete luxuoso, os convidados de uma mansão da alta burguesia descobrem que, por uma barreira psicológica inexplicável, ninguém consegue atravessar a porta e sair.
curatorReason: A sátira surrealista máxima de Luis Buñuel: a rápida degradação da civilidade aristocrática sob o confinamento involuntário.

omdb.title: The Exterminating Angel
omdb.actors: Silvia Pinal, Jacqueline Andere, Enrique Rambal
omdb.plot: The guests at an upper-class dinner party find themselves unable to leave.

title: The Lobster
curatorNote: Comédia surreal distópica de Yorgos Lanthimos. Em um futuro próximo, pessoas solteiras são confinadas em um hotel e têm 45 dias para encontrar um parceiro ou virar um animal.
curatorReason: Sátira desconcertante e brilhante sobre as pressões sociais da monogamia e a alienação dos afetos contemporâneos.

omdb.title: The Lobster
omdb.actors: Colin Farrell, Rachel Weisz, Jessica Barden
omdb.plot: A love story set in a dystopian near future where single people are arrested and transferred to a creepy hotel. There they are obliged to find a matching mate in 45 days. If they fail, they are transformed into an animal and released into the woods.
omdb.country: Ireland, United Kingdom, Greece, France, Netherlands, Belgium, United States
omdb.awards: Nominated for 1 Oscar. 35 wins & 84 nominations total

title: Eternal Sunshine of the Spotless Mind
ptTitle: Brilho Eterno de uma Mente sem Lembranças
curatorNote: Vencedor do Oscar de Melhor Roteiro Original de Charlie Kaufman, dirigido por Michel Gondry com Jim Carrey e Kate Winslet.
curatorReason: Uma viagem onírica e comovente pelos labirintos da memória, provando a impossibilidade de apagar as marcas do amor vivido sem destruir a própria alma.

omdb.title: Eternal Sunshine of the Spotless Mind
omdb.writer: Charlie Kaufman, Michel Gondry, Pierre Bismuth
omdb.actors: Jim Carrey, Kate Winslet, Tom Wilkinson
omdb.plot: Much to his surprise, timid Joel Barish is shocked to discover that the love of his life, sparky Clementine, has had him erased from her memory. As a result, hurt and angry, Joel wants to pay her back in the same coin, going as far as to undergo a painless but intricate medical procedure to do the same. However, poor Joel is utterly unaware that darkness is an essential part of the light. And as the once-cherished recollections of Clementine gradually fade away, giving way to a soulless black void, something unexpected happens. Now Joel has second thoughts, toying with the idea of stopping the irreversible process. Who said ignorance is bliss?

streamName: Brilho Eterno de uma Mente sem Lembranças

title: Beau Is Afraid
curatorNote: Odisseia surrealista e claustrofóbica de Ari Aster com Joaquin Phoenix. Um homem paranoico e ansioso empreende uma jornada kafkiana para visitar sua mãe dominadora.
curatorReason: Um épico de pesadelo psicológico que materializa a culpa, o medo freudiano e o terror neurótico em cenários bizarros e hilariantes.

omdb.title: Beau Is Afraid
omdb.actors: Joaquin Phoenix, Patti LuPone, Amy Ryan
omdb.plot: With his mother's gloomy spectre looming over his entire life, grizzled outcast Beau has never made sense of his miserable existence. And perpetually baffled by reality and his conflicting urgent needs, the neurotic New Yorker gets a hearty slice of crippling anxiety and sheer paranoia when he sets foot in a strangely familiar war zone: his neighbourhood. But as the pill-popping hermit reluctantly embarks on a Sisyphean quest for answers, determined to reunite with his estranged mum at all costs, Beau must summon every last ounce of courage to confront everything that has kept him in the dark. To have a fighting chance of deciphering the sinister secrets that continue to rule his life, Beau must grapple with deep-seated phobias, deal with heavy guilt, and face the menacing parent. Because, in his case, love was a fiendish trap--the labyrinthine depths of maternal affection were only the means to an end. Now, the drugs don't work, and Beau is afraid. As the universe conspires against his conquest and the end draws near, will Beau be able to fight his inner demons for a change?
omdb.country: United States, United Kingdom, Finland, Canada

title: Enemy
curatorNote: Suspense psicológico surreal de Denis Villeneuve adaptando José Saramago, com Jake Gyllenhaal em papel duplo. Um professor descobre um ator fisicamente idêntico a ele.
curatorReason: Um mergulho hipnótico e amarelo em temas de masculinidade tóxica, subconsciente reprimido e teias invisíveis de controle psicológico.

omdb.title: Masterminds
omdb.writer: Chris Bowman, Hubbel Palmer, Emily Spivey
omdb.actors: Zach Galifianakis, Owen Wilson, Kristen Wiig
omdb.plot: David Ghantt discovers the true meaning of adventure far beyond his wildest dreams. He is an uncomplicated man stuck in a monotonous life. Day in and day out he drives an armored vehicle, transporting millions of other people's money with no escape in sight. The only glimmer of excitement is his flirtatious work crush Kelly Campbell who soon lures him into the scheme of a lifetime. Along with a group of half-brained criminals led by Steve Chambers and an absurdly faulted heist plan, David manages the impossible and makes off with $17 million in cash...only problem is he foolishly hands the money over to this wild group of double crossers and has been set up to take the fall. With the bandits blowing the millions on lavish and ridiculous luxuries, they leave behind a glaring trail of evidence. Now on the lam and in over his head, David must dodge the authorities, evade a hilarious hit man, Mike McKinney, and try to turn the tables on the ones he trusted most.

title: Synecdoche, New York
curatorNote: Estreia de Charlie Kaufman na direção com Philip Seymour Hoffman. Um diretor de teatro constrói uma réplica em tamanho real de Nova York dentro de um armazém para encenar sua vida.
curatorReason: O cume da metaficção existencialista: um monumento trágico e genial sobre mortalidade, solidão e a impossibilidade de representar a totalidade da existência.

omdb.title: Synecdoche, New York
omdb.actors: Philip Seymour Hoffman, Samantha Morton, Michelle Williams
omdb.plot: Theater director Caden Cotard is mounting a new play. Fresh off of a successful production of "Death of a Salesman", he has traded in the suburban blue-hairs and regional theater of Schenectady for the cultured audiences and bright footlights of Broadway. Armed with a MacArthur grant and determined to create a piece of brutal realism and honesty, something into which he can put his whole self, he gathers an ensemble cast into a warehouse in Manhattan's theater r very He directs them in a celebration of the mundane, instructing each to live out their constructed lives in a small mock-up of the city outside. As the city inside the warehouse grows, Caden's own life veers wildly off the tracks. The shadow of his ex-wife Adele, a celebrated painter who left him years ago for Germany's art scene, sneers at him from every corner. Somewhere in Berlin, his daughter Olive is growing up under the questionable guidance of Adele's friend Maria. He's helplessly driving his marriage to actress Claire into the ground. Sammy Barnathan, the actor Caden has hired to play himself within the play, is a bit too perfect for the part, and is making it difficult for Caden to revive his relationship with the alluringly candid Hazel. Meanwhile, his therapist, Madeline Gravis, is better at plugging her best-seller than she is at counseling him. His second daughter, Ariel, is disabled. And a mysterious condition is systematically shutting down each of his autonomic functions, one by one. As the years rapidly pass, Caden buries himself deeper into his masterpiece. Populating the cast and crew with doppelgangers, he steadily blurs the line between the world of the play and that of his own deteriorating reality. As he pushes the limits of his relationships, both personally and professionally, a change in creative direction arrives in Millicent Weems, a celebrated theater actress who may offer Caden the break he needs.
